purpose: Teach: 三国志/ハンマー/バイキング/スターウォーズ/カーニバル/肺炎/領事館/赤ワイン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三国志の漫画を買って下さったんですって?
lines.en: Sho, I heard your dad bought you that Three Kingdoms manga. That's exciting.
lines.style: Warm curiosity, genuinely interested in what delights him. Soft opening. Leaning in slightly, eyes bright. No rush in the pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、図工でハンマーを使う授業があるんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we're doing this thing in art class where we use hammers.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo, animated hand. The excitement of telling someone he trusts about something new. Slight breathiness on the rush of words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとバイキング料理のお店に行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, you know what? I'd really like to go to that Viking restaurant with your dad sometime.
lines.style: Soft, almost thinking aloud. Gentle pause before 'that Viking restaurant.' Wistful but not sad — the tone of someone noticing something she wants. Warm undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとスターウォーズ観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to see Star Wars with Mom the other day.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share his own news back. The happiness of having something to offer in return. Natural, conversational pace. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、地域のカーニバルに参加しましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the community carnival together, okay?
lines.style: Gentle invitation, no pressure underneath. Tender opening. Slow, deliberate pace. The care of someone making sure he feels included and safe. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが肺炎にならないか心配だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm worried Grandpa might get pneumonia.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine worry. The hesitant vulnerability of a child telling someone he trusts about a fear. Slow, careful pacing. No performance — just honest concern.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが領事館で書類のお仕事してらっしゃるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been working with documents at the consulate, I understand.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing detail. Gentle delivery, matter-of-fact but not dismissive. The tone of someone piecing together someone else's life with care. Steady pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが赤ワインで乾杯してらしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad made a toast with red wine earlier.
lines.style: Bright, immediate, sharing fresh memory. Quick pace. The eagerness of a child rushing to tell something he just witnessed. Open, unguarded delivery.
